cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a QA Documentation Specialist/QC Lab Support to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
The QA Documentation Specialist shall develop, implement & maintain end-to-end Quality Assurance documentation.
Write, review, and implement company-wide deployment of Quality Assurance Documentation, including but not limited to – Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Instructions, Forms, Job Aids, Process Flows. Catalog & maintain all Manufacturing & Quality documentation. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify areas of opportunity to develop necessary documentation, practices, and processes. Train cross-functional teams during implementation of new procedures & practices. Perform & document product evaluations for conformance to listed specifications. Initiate & manage product non-conformances including but not limited to receiving & inspection, in-line & finished production, and customer rejects/returns. Oversee the documentation of the Corrective Action Preventative Action (CAPA) lifecycle from initiation of root cause investigations through implementation of corrective actions. Digitalize production records and identify potential trends. Assist production, warehouse, and quality personnel as required. Perform timely escalations with strong communication skills across all levels of organization.
The QC Lab Technician shall perform all in-house analytical testing of products to verify & validate incoming COA submissions through the testing of pH, viscosity, and density, as well as managing a Stability/Compatibility program to provide analytical reports & support NPI development.
Create & maintain a product specific COA library & perform periodic checks on finished good standards. Routinely calibrate all laboratory equipment & maintain a maintenance log. Establish & maintain laboratory testing logs for all analytical testing performed. Adhere to basic principles of GLP & expand these practices department wide. Execute & document stability/compatibility testing meeting mandatory pull dates. Collect, label, analyze, document, report, and communicate all analytical inspection activities. Perform product assessments, including but not limited to – Physical: Color, Odor, Appearance, etc. Analytical: Torque, Specific gravity, pH, Viscosity, etc. Analyze product characteristics against established specifications/standards to determine disposition (i.e. Pass/fail). Perform timely escalations with strong communication skills using appropriate terminology. Under the guidance of the Quality supervisor, facilitate & assist in unique audit requests & testing when required. Prepare sample submissions and related documentation for third party testing. Assist production, warehouse, and quality personnel as required.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Strong written & verbal communication skills in English.
Prior experience & knowledge in writing, developing, and implementing SOPs.
Ability to prioritize & pivot daily activities driven by production urgency.
Prior experience working in a regulated industry or liquid filling/manufacturing environment.
Interest in development of processes & documentation supporting a manufacturing & production environment.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree from an accredited university and/or specialty in Technical Writing.
Proficiency in Spanish.
American Society for Quality (ASQ) Certified Quality Inspector (CQI).

cond_0060.intro:
We are looking for a QA Documentation Specialist/QC Lab Support to join our team at [Company name masked] in [Location masked].
This role supports both QA and QC responsibilities. The right person will have strong QA documentation experience and be able to perform pH testing and viscosity testing in the laboratory. You will regularly work with people across the organization — from production and warehouse staff to cross-functional teams — and be expected to communicate clearly and proactively at all levels.
cond_0060.responsibilities:
QA Documentation Specialist
Write, review, and roll out Quality Assurance documentation company-wide, including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Instructions, Forms, Job Aids, and Process Flows.
Catalog and maintain all Manufacturing and Quality documentation.
Connect regularly with cross-functional teams to identify gaps and develop necessary documentation, practices, and processes.
Train cross-functional teams when new procedures and practices are introduced.
Perform and document product evaluations for conformance to listed specifications.
Initiate and manage product non-conformances, including receiving and inspection, in-line and finished production, and customer rejects/returns.
Oversee documentation of the Corrective Action Preventative Action (CAPA) lifecycle from root cause investigations through implementation of corrective actions.
Digitalize production records and identify potential trends.
Assist production, warehouse, and quality personnel as needed.
Perform timely escalations and communicate clearly across all levels of the organization.
QC Lab Technician
Create and maintain a product-specific COA library and perform periodic checks on finished goods standards.
Routinely calibrate all laboratory equipment and maintain a maintenance log.
Establish and maintain laboratory testing logs for all analytical testing performed.
Adhere to basic principles of GLP and help expand these practices across the department.
Execute and document stability/compatibility testing, meeting mandatory pull dates.
Collect, label, analyze, document, report, and communicate all analytical inspection activities — staying in regular contact with relevant team members throughout.
Perform product assessments including Physical (Color, Odor, Appearance) and Analytical (Torque, Specific gravity, pH, Viscosity).
Analyze product characteristics against established specifications to determine disposition (pass/fail).
Perform timely escalations using appropriate terminology and clear communication.
Under the guidance of the Quality supervisor, facilitate and assist in unique audit requests and testing when required.
Prepare sample submissions and related documentation for third-party testing.
Assist production, warehouse, and quality personnel as needed.
cond_0060.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
Prior experience writing, developing, and implementing SOPs.
Ability to prioritize and adjust daily activities based on production urgency.
Prior experience working in a regulated industry or liquid filling/manufacturing environment.
Interest in quality and process/documentation development in a manufacturing and production setting.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree from an accredited university and/or specialty in Technical Writing.
Proficiency in Spanish.
American Society for Quality (ASQ) Certified Quality Inspector (CQI).

Coordinate with cross-functional teams to write, review, and roll out Quality Assurance Documentation, including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Instructions, Forms, Job Aids, and Process Flows.
Catalog and maintain all Manufacturing and Quality documentation together with relevant stakeholders.
Work alongside cross-functional teams to identify areas of opportunity and develop necessary documentation, practices, and processes.
Support cross-functional teams during implementation of new procedures and practices through training.
Perform and document product evaluations for conformance to listed specifications.
Initiate and manage product non-conformances, including receiving and inspection, in-line and finished production, and customer rejects/returns.
Coordinate the documentation of the Corrective Action Preventative Action (CAPA) lifecycle from initiation of root cause investigations through implementation of corrective actions.
Help digitalize production records and work with the team to identify potential trends.
Assist production, warehouse, and quality personnel as required.
Ensure timely escalations with clear communication across all levels of the organization.
QC Lab Technician Responsibilities:
The QC Lab Technician will work with the quality team to perform all in-house analytical testing of products to verify and validate incoming COA submissions through the testing of pH, viscosity, and density, and will help manage a Stability/Compatibility program to provide analytical reports and support NPI development.
Create and maintain a product-specific COA library and coordinate periodic checks on finished good standards.
Routinely calibrate all laboratory equipment and maintain a shared maintenance log.
Establish and maintain laboratory testing logs for all analytical testing performed.
Adhere to basic principles of GLP and help expand these practices department-wide.
Execute and document stability/compatibility testing meeting mandatory pull dates.
Collect, label, analyze, document, report, and communicate all analytical inspection activities.
Perform product assessments, including Physical (Color, Odor, Appearance, etc.) and Analytical (Torque, Specific gravity, pH, Viscosity, etc.).
Analyze product characteristics against established specifications/standards to determine disposition (i.e. Pass/fail).
Ensure timely escalations with clear communication using appropriate terminology.
Under the guidance of the Quality supervisor, help facilitate and assist in unique audit requests and testing when required.
Prepare sample submissions and related documentation for third-party testing.
Assist production, warehouse, and quality personnel as required.
cond_0252.requirements:
Interest in quality and experience developing processes and documentation in a manufacturing or production environment.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Proficiency in Spanish is a plus.
Prior experience and knowledge in writing, developing, and implementing SOPs.
Ability to prioritize and adjust daily activities based on production urgency.
Bachelor's degree from an accredited university and/or specialty in Technical Writing.
Prior experience working in a regulated industry or liquid filling/manufacturing environment.
American Society for Quality (ASQ) Certified Quality Inspector (CQI).

cond_0269.intro:
We are looking for a QA Documentation Specialist/QC Lab Support to join our team at [Company name masked], an automotive chemical manufacturer.
We are looking for one individual to own both QA and QC responsibilities. This person should have strong QA documentation experience and be able to execute pH testing and viscosity testing in the laboratory.
The QA Documentation Specialist will develop, implement, and maintain end-to-end Quality Assurance documentation.
cond_0269.responsibilities:
QA Documentation Specialist Responsibilities:
Develop, write, review, and deploy company-wide Quality Assurance Documentation, including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Instructions, Forms, Job Aids, and Process Flows.
Own the cataloging and maintenance of all Manufacturing and Quality documentation.
Lead cross-functional collaboration to identify gaps and drive the development of necessary documentation, practices, and processes.
Deliver training to cross-functional teams during implementation of new procedures and practices.
Execute and document product evaluations for conformance to listed specifications.
Initiate and manage product non-conformances including receiving and inspection, in-line and finished production, and customer rejects/returns.
Direct the documentation of the Corrective Action Preventative Action (CAPA) lifecycle from root cause investigation through implementation of corrective actions.
Digitalize production records and identify potential trends.
Support production, warehouse, and quality personnel as required.
Escalate issues in a timely manner with clear communication across all levels of the organization.
QC Lab Technician Responsibilities:
Execute all in-house analytical testing of products to verify and validate incoming COA submissions through pH, viscosity, and density testing.
Manage a Stability/Compatibility program to deliver analytical reports and support NPI development.
Create and maintain a product-specific COA library and conduct periodic checks on finished good standards.
Calibrate all laboratory equipment on a routine basis and maintain a maintenance log.
Establish and maintain laboratory testing logs for all analytical testing performed.
Apply and expand GLP principles department-wide.
Execute and document stability/compatibility testing meeting mandatory pull dates.
Collect, label, analyze, document, report, and communicate all analytical inspection activities.
Perform product assessments including Physical (Color, Odor, Appearance) and Analytical (Torque, Specific Gravity, pH, Viscosity) evaluations.
Analyze product characteristics against established specifications to determine disposition (pass/fail).
Escalate issues in a timely manner using appropriate terminology.
Facilitate and execute unique audit requests and testing under the guidance of the Quality supervisor.
Prepare sample submissions and related documentation for third-party testing.
Support production, warehouse, and quality personnel as required.

We are looking for a QA Documentation Specialist/QC Lab Support to join our team at [Company name masked], an automotive chemical manufacturer located at [Location masked].
This role covers both QA and QC responsibilities. The right person will have solid QA documentation experience and be able to perform pH and viscosity testing in the laboratory.
The QA Documentation Specialist will develop, implement, and maintain end-to-end Quality Assurance documentation.
cond_0277.responsibilities:
QA Documentation
Write, review, and implement company-wide Quality Assurance Documentation, including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Instructions, Forms, Job Aids, and Process Flows.
Catalog and maintain all Manufacturing and Quality documentation.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams to identify gaps and develop necessary documentation, practices, and processes.
Deliver training to relevant teams during implementation of new procedures and practices.
Perform and document product evaluations for conformance to listed specifications.
Initiate and manage product non-conformances, including receiving and inspection, in-line and finished production, and customer rejects/returns.
Oversee documentation of the Corrective Action Preventative Action (CAPA) lifecycle from root cause investigation through implementation of corrective actions.
Digitalize production records and identify potential trends.
Support production, warehouse, and quality personnel as required.
Escalate issues in a timely manner with clear, direct communication across all levels of the organization.
QC Lab Technician
The QC Lab Technician will perform all in-house analytical testing to verify and validate incoming COA submissions through pH, viscosity, and density testing, and will manage a Stability/Compatibility program to provide analytical reports and support NPI development.
Create and maintain a product-specific COA library and perform periodic checks on finished goods standards.
Routinely calibrate all laboratory equipment and maintain a maintenance log.
Establish and maintain laboratory testing logs for all analytical testing performed.
Adhere to basic GLP principles and help expand these practices across the department.
Execute and document stability/compatibility testing in line with mandatory pull dates.
Collect, label, analyze, document, and report all analytical inspection activities.
Perform product assessments including Physical (Color, Odor, Appearance) and Analytical (Torque, Specific Gravity, pH, Viscosity) evaluations.
Assess product characteristics against established specifications to determine disposition (pass/fail).
Escalate issues in a timely manner using clear, direct communication and appropriate terminology.
Under the guidance of the Quality supervisor, assist with audit requests and testing when required.
Prepare sample submissions and related documentation for third-party testing.
Support production, warehouse, and quality personnel as required.
cond_0277.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
Prior experience writing, developing, and implementing SOPs.
Ability to prioritize and adjust daily activities based on production needs.
Prior experience in a regulated industry or liquid filling/manufacturing environment.
Bachelor's degree from an accredited university and/or specialty in Technical Writing.
Preferred Requirements
Proficiency in Spanish.
American Society for Quality (ASQ) Certified Quality Inspector (CQI).
Interest in developing processes and documentation in a manufacturing and production environment.

We are looking for one individual to support both QA and QC responsibilities. This person should have strong QA documentation experience and be able to perform pH testing and viscosity testing in the laboratory.
The QA Documentation Specialist will work with the team to develop, implement, and maintain end-to-end Quality Assurance documentation.
cond_0324.responsibilities:
QA Documentation Responsibilities:
Coordinate with cross-functional teams to write, review, and roll out Quality Assurance Documentation, including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Instructions, Forms, Job Aids, and Process Flows.
Catalog and maintain all Manufacturing and Quality documentation together with relevant stakeholders.
Work alongside cross-functional teams to identify areas of opportunity and develop necessary documentation, practices, and processes.
Support cross-functional teams during implementation of new procedures and practices through training.
Perform and document product evaluations for conformance to listed specifications.
Initiate and manage product non-conformances, including receiving and inspection, in-line and finished production, and customer rejects/returns.
Coordinate the documentation of the Corrective Action Preventative Action (CAPA) lifecycle from initiation of root cause investigations through implementation of corrective actions.
Help digitalize production records and work with the team to identify potential trends.
Assist production, warehouse, and quality personnel as required.
Ensure timely escalations with clear communication across all levels of the organization.

The QC Lab Technician will work with the quality team to perform all in-house analytical testing of products to verify and validate incoming COA submissions through the testing of pH, viscosity, and density, and will help manage a Stability/Compatibility program to provide analytical reports and support NPI development.
Create and maintain a product-specific COA library and coordinate periodic checks on finished good standards.
Routinely calibrate all laboratory equipment and maintain a shared maintenance log.
Establish and maintain laboratory testing logs for all analytical testing performed.
Adhere to basic principles of GLP and help expand these practices department-wide.
Execute and document stability/compatibility testing meeting mandatory pull dates.
Collect, label, analyze, document, report, and communicate all analytical inspection activities.
Perform product assessments, including Physical (Color, Odor, Appearance, etc.) and Analytical (Torque, Specific gravity, pH, Viscosity, etc.).
Analyze product characteristics against established specifications/standards to determine disposition (i.e. Pass/fail).
Ensure timely escalations with clear communication using appropriate terminology.
Under the guidance of the Quality supervisor, help facilitate and assist in unique audit requests and testing when required.
Prepare sample submissions and related documentation for third-party testing.
Assist production, warehouse, and quality personnel as required.

cond_0333.intro:
We are looking for a QA Documentation Specialist/QC Lab Support to join our team at [Company name masked], an automotive chemical manufacturer.
This role supports both QA and QC responsibilities. The right person will bring solid QA documentation experience and be able to carry out pH, viscosity, and density testing in the lab.
The QA side of the role involves working with cross-functional teams to develop, implement, and maintain end-to-end Quality Assurance documentation.
cond_0333.responsibilities:
QA Documentation
Work with teams across the organization to write, review, and roll out Quality Assurance documentation, including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Instructions, Forms, Job Aids, and Process Flows.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams to catalog and maintain all Manufacturing and Quality documentation.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify gaps and develop necessary documentation, practices, and processes.
Support cross-functional teams during implementation of new procedures and practices through training.
Coordinate product evaluations for conformance to listed specifications and document findings.
Work with relevant teams to initiate and manage product non-conformances, including receiving and inspection, in-line and finished production, and customer rejects/returns.
Support the documentation of the Corrective Action Preventative Action (CAPA) lifecycle, from root cause investigations through implementation of corrective actions.
Help digitalize production records and share identified trends with the team.
Assist production, warehouse, and quality personnel as needed.
Ensure timely escalations with clear communication across all levels of the organization.
QC Lab Technician
The QC Lab Technician works alongside the quality team to perform all in-house analytical testing of products, verifying and validating incoming COA submissions through pH, viscosity, and density testing, and supporting a Stability/Compatibility program to provide analytical reports and assist NPI development.
Coordinate with the team to create and maintain a product-specific COA library and perform periodic checks on finished good standards.
Routinely calibrate all laboratory equipment and maintain a shared maintenance log.
Establish and maintain laboratory testing logs for all analytical testing performed.
Adhere to basic principles of GLP and help expand these practices across the department.
Execute and document stability/compatibility testing in line with mandatory pull dates.
Collect, label, analyze, document, report, and communicate all analytical inspection activities.
Perform product assessments including Physical (Color, Odor, Appearance, etc.) and Analytical (Torque, Specific gravity, pH, Viscosity, etc.).
Work with the team to analyze product characteristics against established specifications/standards to determine disposition (pass/fail).
Ensure timely escalations using appropriate terminology and clear communication.
Under the guidance of the Quality supervisor, help facilitate and assist with unique audit requests and testing when required.
Prepare sample submissions and related documentation for third-party testing.
Assist production, warehouse, and quality personnel as required.
cond_0333.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
Prior experience writing, developing, and implementing SOPs.
Ability to prioritize and adjust daily activities based on production urgency.
Prior experience working in a regulated industry or liquid filling/manufacturing environment.
Interest in quality and process/documentation development in a manufacturing and production setting.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree from an accredited university and/or specialty in Technical Writing.
Proficiency in Spanish.
American Society for Quality (ASQ) Certified Quality Inspector (CQI).

cond_0360.intro:
We are looking for a QA Documentation Specialist/QC Lab Support to join our team at [Company name masked], an automotive chemical manufacturer.
We are looking for one individual to support both QA and QC responsibilities. This person should have strong QA documentation experience and be able to perform pH testing and viscosity testing in the laboratory.
The QA Documentation Specialist will work with the team to develop, implement, and maintain end-to-end Quality Assurance documentation.
cond_0360.responsibilities:
QA Documentation Responsibilities:
Coordinate with cross-functional teams to write, review, and roll out Quality Assurance Documentation, including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Instructions, Forms, Job Aids, and Process Flows.
Catalog and maintain all Manufacturing and Quality documentation together with relevant stakeholders.
Work alongside cross-functional teams to identify areas of opportunity and develop necessary documentation, practices, and processes.
Support cross-functional teams during implementation of new procedures and practices through training.
Perform and document product evaluations for conformance to listed specifications.
Initiate and manage product non-conformances, including receiving and inspection, in-line and finished production, and customer rejects/returns.
Coordinate the documentation of the Corrective Action Preventative Action (CAPA) lifecycle from initiation of root cause investigations through implementation of corrective actions.
Help digitalize production records and work with the team to identify potential trends.
Assist production, warehouse, and quality personnel as required.
Ensure timely escalations with clear communication across all levels of the organization.
QC Lab Technician Responsibilities:
The QC Lab Technician will work with the quality team to perform all in-house analytical testing of products to verify and validate incoming COA submissions through the testing of pH, viscosity, and density, and will help manage a Stability/Compatibility program to provide analytical reports and support NPI development.
Create and maintain a product-specific COA library and coordinate periodic checks on finished good standards.
Routinely calibrate all laboratory equipment and maintain a shared maintenance log.
Establish and maintain laboratory testing logs for all analytical testing performed.
Adhere to basic principles of GLP and help expand these practices department-wide.
Execute and document stability/compatibility testing meeting mandatory pull dates.
Collect, label, analyze, document, report, and communicate all analytical inspection activities.
Perform product assessments, including Physical (Color, Odor, Appearance, etc.) and Analytical (Torque, Specific gravity, pH, Viscosity, etc.).
Analyze product characteristics against established specifications/standards to determine disposition (i.e. Pass/fail).
Ensure timely escalations with clear communication using appropriate terminology.
Under the guidance of the Quality supervisor, help facilitate and assist in unique audit requests and testing when required.
Prepare sample submissions and related documentation for third-party testing.
Assist production, warehouse, and quality personnel as required.
cond_0360.requirements:
Interest in quality and experience developing processes and documentation in a manufacturing or production environment.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Proficiency in Spanish is a plus.
Prior experience and knowledge in writing, developing, and implementing SOPs.
Ability to prioritize and adjust daily activities based on production urgency.
Bachelor's degree from an accredited university and/or specialty in Technical Writing.
Prior experience working in a regulated industry or liquid filling/manufacturing environment.
American Society for Quality (ASQ) Certified Quality Inspector (CQI).

Coordinate with cross-functional teams to catalog and maintain all Manufacturing and Quality documentation.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify gaps and develop necessary documentation, practices, and processes.
Support cross-functional teams during implementation of new procedures and practices through training.
Coordinate product evaluations for conformance to listed specifications and document findings.
Work with relevant teams to initiate and manage product non-conformances, including receiving and inspection, in-line and finished production, and customer rejects/returns.

Help digitalize production records and share identified trends with the team.

Coordinate with the team to create and maintain a product-specific COA library and perform periodic checks on finished good standards.
Routinely calibrate all laboratory equipment and maintain a shared maintenance log.
Establish and maintain laboratory testing logs for all analytical testing performed.
Adhere to basic principles of GLP and help expand these practices across the department.
Execute and document stability/compatibility testing in line with mandatory pull dates.
Collect, label, analyze, document, report, and communicate all analytical inspection activities.
Perform product assessments including Physical (Color, Odor, Appearance, etc.) and Analytical (Torque, Specific gravity, pH, Viscosity, etc.).
Work with the team to analyze product characteristics against established specifications/standards to determine disposition (pass/fail).
Ensure timely escalations using appropriate terminology and clear communication.
Under the guidance of the Quality supervisor, help facilitate and assist with unique audit requests and testing when required.
Prepare sample submissions and related documentation for third-party testing.
Assist production, warehouse, and quality personnel as required.

Write, review, and implement company-wide deployment of Quality Assurance Documentation, including but not limited to – Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Instructions, Forms, Job Aids, Process Flows. Catalog & maintain all Manufacturing & Quality documentation. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify areas of opportunity to develop necessary documentation, practices, and processes. Train cross-functional teams during implementation of new procedures & practices. Perform & document product evaluations for conformance to listed specifications. Initiate & manage product non-conformances including but not limited to receiving & inspection, in-line & finished production, and customer rejects/returns. Oversee the documentation of the Corrective Action Preventative Action (CAPA) lifecycle from initiation of root cause investigations through implementation of corrective actions. Digitalize production records and identify potential trends. Assist production, warehouse, and quality personnel as required. Perform timely escalations with strong communication skills across all levels of organization.
Job Responsibilities
Create & maintain a product specific COA library & perform periodic checks on finished good standards. Routinely calibrate all laboratory equipment & maintain a maintenance log. Establish & maintain laboratory testing logs for all analytical testing performed. Adhere to basic principles of GLP & expand these practices department wide. Execute & document stability/compatibility testing meeting mandatory pull dates. Collect, label, analyze, document, report, and communicate all analytical inspection activities. Perform product assessments, including but not limited to – Physical: Color, Odor, Appearance, etc. Analytical: Torque, Specific gravity, pH, Viscosity, etc. Analyze product characteristics against established specifications/standards to determine disposition (i.e. Pass/fail). Perform timely escalations with strong communication skills using appropriate terminology. Under the guidance of the Quality supervisor, facilitate & assist in unique audit requests & testing when required. Prepare sample submissions and related documentation for third party testing. Assist production, warehouse, and quality personnel as required.
cond_0426.requirements: Interest in quality and a willingness to develop processes & documentation in a manufacturing & production environment. Ability to communicate effectively in writing and verbally in English. Familiarity with Spanish is a plus. Some experience with writing, developing, and implementing SOPs, or a willingness to build that skill. Ability to prioritize & adjust daily activities driven by production needs. Bachelor's degree from an accredited university and/or background in Technical Writing, or equivalent practical experience. Experience working in a regulated industry or liquid filling/manufacturing environment is helpful but candidates with transferable backgrounds are welcome to apply. American Society for Quality (ASQ) Certified Quality Inspector (CQI), or willingness to obtain.
cond_0426.values: We value ambition, achievement, and consistent follow-through. We believe strong outcomes come from maintaining high expectations for the work we do.

The QA Documentation Specialist shall develop, implement & maintain end-to-end Quality Assurance documentation.
Write, review, and implement company-wide deployment of Quality Assurance Documentation, including but not limited to – Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Instructions, Forms, Job Aids, Process Flows. Catalog & maintain all Manufacturing & Quality documentation. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify areas of opportunity to develop necessary documentation, practices, and processes. Train cross-functional teams during implementation of new procedures & practices. Perform & document product evaluations for conformance to listed specifications. Initiate & manage product non-conformances including but not limited to receiving & inspection, in-line & finished production, and customer rejects/returns. Oversee the documentation of the Corrective Action Preventative Action (CAPA) lifecycle from initiation of root cause investigations through implementation of corrective actions. Digitalize production records and identify potential trends. Assist production, warehouse, and quality personnel as required. Perform timely escalations with strong communication skills across all levels of organization.
The QC Lab Technician shall perform all in-house analytical testing of products to verify & validate incoming COA submissions through the testing of pH, viscosity, and density, as well as managing a Stability/Compatibility program to provide analytical reports & support NPI development.
Create & maintain a product specific COA library & perform periodic checks on finished good standards. Routinely calibrate all laboratory equipment & maintain a maintenance log. Establish & maintain laboratory testing logs for all analytical testing performed. Adhere to basic principles of GLP & expand these practices department wide. Execute & document stability/compatibility testing meeting mandatory pull dates. Collect, label, analyze, document, report, and communicate all analytical inspection activities. Perform product assessments, including but not limited to – Physical: Color, Odor, Appearance, etc. Analytical: Torque, Specific gravity, pH, Viscosity, etc. Analyze product characteristics against established specifications/standards to determine disposition (i.e. Pass/fail). Perform timely escalations with strong communication skills using appropriate terminology. Under the guidance of the Quality supervisor, facilitate & assist in unique audit requests & testing when required. Prepare sample submissions and related documentation for third party testing. Assist production, warehouse, and quality personnel as required.
cond_0471.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Interest in quality and experience developing processes & documentation in a manufacturing or production environment.
Strong written & verbal communication skills in English.
Some experience with writing, developing, and implementing SOPs.
Ability to prioritize & adjust daily activities based on production needs.
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience, with a background or specialty in Technical Writing.
Experience working in a regulated industry or liquid filling/manufacturing environment.
Preferred Requirements
Working knowledge of Spanish is a plus.
American Society for Quality (ASQ) Certified Quality Inspector (CQI), or willingness to obtain.

The QA Documentation Specialist shall develop, implement & maintain end-to-end Quality Assurance documentation.
Write, review, and implement company-wide deployment of Quality Assurance Documentation, including but not limited to – Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Instructions, Forms, Job Aids, Process Flows. Catalog & maintain all Manufacturing & Quality documentation. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify areas of opportunity to develop necessary documentation, practices, and processes. Train cross-functional teams during implementation of new procedures & practices. Perform & document product evaluations for conformance to listed specifications. Initiate & manage product non-conformances including but not limited to receiving & inspection, in-line & finished production, and customer rejects/returns. Oversee the documentation of the Corrective Action Preventative Action (CAPA) lifecycle from initiation of root cause investigations through implementation of corrective actions. Digitalize production records and identify potential trends. Assist production, warehouse, and quality personnel as required. Perform timely escalations with strong communication skills across all levels of organization.
The QC Lab Technician shall perform all in-house analytical testing of products to verify & validate incoming COA submissions through the testing of pH, viscosity, and density, as well as managing a Stability/Compatibility program to provide analytical reports & support NPI development.
Create & maintain a product specific COA library & perform periodic checks on finished good standards. Routinely calibrate all laboratory equipment & maintain a maintenance log. Establish & maintain laboratory testing logs for all analytical testing performed. Adhere to basic principles of GLP & expand these practices department wide. Execute & document stability/compatibility testing meeting mandatory pull dates. Collect, label, analyze, document, report, and communicate all analytical inspection activities. Perform product assessments, including but not limited to – Physical: Color, Odor, Appearance, etc. Analytical: Torque, Specific gravity, pH, Viscosity, etc. Analyze product characteristics against established specifications/standards to determine disposition (i.e. Pass/fail). Perform timely escalations with strong communication skills using appropriate terminology. Under the guidance of the Quality supervisor, facilitate & assist in unique audit requests & testing when required. Prepare sample submissions and related documentation for third party testing. Assist production, warehouse, and quality personnel as required.
cond_0488.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Demonstrated expertise in writing, developing, and implementing SOPs.
Proven track record working in a regulated industry or liquid filling/manufacturing environment.
Bachelor's degree from an accredited university and/or specialty in Technical Writing required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Exceptional written & verbal communication skills in English.
Strong ability to prioritize & pivot daily activities driven by production urgency.
Preferred Requirements
American Society for Quality (ASQ) Certified Quality Inspector (CQI).
Proficiency in Spanish.

cond_0497.intro: We are looking for a QA Documentation Specialist/QC Lab Support to join our team.
cond_0497.responsibilities:
Position Description
Write, review, and implement company-wide deployment of Quality Assurance Documentation, including but not limited to – Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Instructions, Forms, Job Aids, Process Flows. Catalog & maintain all Manufacturing & Quality documentation. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify areas of opportunity to develop necessary documentation, practices, and processes. Train cross-functional teams during implementation of new procedures & practices. Perform & document product evaluations for conformance to listed specifications. Initiate & manage product non-conformances including but not limited to receiving & inspection, in-line & finished production, and customer rejects/returns. Oversee the documentation of the Corrective Action Preventative Action (CAPA) lifecycle from initiation of root cause investigations through implementation of corrective actions. Digitalize production records and identify potential trends. Assist production, warehouse, and quality personnel as required. Perform timely escalations with strong communication skills across all levels of organization.
Job Responsibilities
Create & maintain a product specific COA library & perform periodic checks on finished good standards. Routinely calibrate all laboratory equipment & maintain a maintenance log. Establish & maintain laboratory testing logs for all analytical testing performed. Adhere to basic principles of GLP & expand these practices department wide. Execute & document stability/compatibility testing meeting mandatory pull dates. Collect, label, analyze, document, report, and communicate all analytical inspection activities. Perform product assessments, including but not limited to – Physical: Color, Odor, Appearance, etc. Analytical: Torque, Specific gravity, pH, Viscosity, etc. Analyze product characteristics against established specifications/standards to determine disposition (i.e. Pass/fail). Perform timely escalations with strong communication skills using appropriate terminology. Under the guidance of the Quality supervisor, facilitate & assist in unique audit requests & testing when required. Prepare sample submissions and related documentation for third party testing. Assist production, warehouse, and quality personnel as required.
cond_0497.requirements: Demonstrated commitment to Quality with a proven track record in developing processes & documentation within a manufacturing & production environment. Exceptional written & verbal communication skills in English. Proficiency in Spanish is a plus. Substantial prior experience and deep knowledge in writing, developing, and implementing SOPs. Strong ability to prioritize & pivot daily activities driven by production urgency. Bachelor's degree from an accredited university and/or specialty in Technical Writing required; advanced degree strongly preferred. Proven experience working in a regulated industry or liquid filling/manufacturing environment. American Society for Quality (ASQ) Certified Quality Inspector (CQI).

This role supports both QA and QC responsibilities. The right person will have strong QA documentation experience and be able to perform pH testing and viscosity testing in the laboratory. You will regularly work with people across the organization — from production and warehouse staff to cross-functional teams — and be expected to communicate clearly and proactively at all levels.
cond_0546.responsibilities:
QA Documentation Specialist
Write, review, and roll out Quality Assurance documentation company-wide, including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Instructions, Forms, Job Aids, and Process Flows.
Catalog and maintain all Manufacturing and Quality documentation.
Connect regularly with cross-functional teams to identify gaps and develop necessary documentation, practices, and processes.
Train cross-functional teams when new procedures and practices are introduced.
Perform and document product evaluations for conformance to listed specifications.
Initiate and manage product non-conformances, including receiving and inspection, in-line and finished production, and customer rejects/returns.
Oversee documentation of the Corrective Action Preventative Action (CAPA) lifecycle from root cause investigations through implementation of corrective actions.
Digitalize production records and identify potential trends.
Assist production, warehouse, and quality personnel as needed.
Perform timely escalations and communicate clearly across all levels of the organization.
QC Lab Technician
Create and maintain a product-specific COA library and perform periodic checks on finished goods standards.
Routinely calibrate all laboratory equipment and maintain a maintenance log.
Establish and maintain laboratory testing logs for all analytical testing performed.
Adhere to basic principles of GLP and help expand these practices across the department.
Execute and document stability/compatibility testing, meeting mandatory pull dates.
Collect, label, analyze, document, report, and communicate all analytical inspection activities — staying in regular contact with relevant team members throughout.
Perform product assessments including Physical (Color, Odor, Appearance) and Analytical (Torque, Specific gravity, pH, Viscosity).
Analyze product characteristics against established specifications to determine disposition (pass/fail).
Perform timely escalations using appropriate terminology and clear communication.
Under the guidance of the Quality supervisor, facilitate and assist in unique audit requests and testing when required.
Prepare sample submissions and related documentation for third-party testing.
Assist production, warehouse, and quality personnel as needed.
cond_0546.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
Prior experience writing, developing, and implementing SOPs.
Ability to prioritize and adjust daily activities based on production urgency.
Prior experience working in a regulated industry or liquid filling/manufacturing environment.
Interest in quality and process/documentation development in a manufacturing and production setting.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree from an accredited university and/or specialty in Technical Writing.
Proficiency in Spanish.
American Society for Quality (ASQ) Certified Quality Inspector (CQI).
cond_0546.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

Develop, write, review, and deploy company-wide Quality Assurance Documentation, including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Instructions, Forms, Job Aids, and Process Flows.
Own the cataloging and maintenance of all Manufacturing and Quality documentation.
Lead cross-functional collaboration to identify gaps and drive the development of necessary documentation, practices, and processes.
Deliver training to cross-functional teams during implementation of new procedures and practices.
Execute and document product evaluations for conformance to listed specifications.
Initiate and manage product non-conformances including receiving and inspection, in-line and finished production, and customer rejects/returns.
Direct the documentation of the Corrective Action Preventative Action (CAPA) lifecycle from root cause investigation through implementation of corrective actions.
Digitalize production records and identify potential trends.
Support production, warehouse, and quality personnel as required.
Escalate issues in a timely manner with clear communication across all levels of the organization.
QC Lab Technician Responsibilities:
Execute all in-house analytical testing of products to verify and validate incoming COA submissions through pH, viscosity, and density testing.
Manage a Stability/Compatibility program to deliver analytical reports and support NPI development.
Create and maintain a product-specific COA library and conduct periodic checks on finished good standards.
Calibrate all laboratory equipment on a routine basis and maintain a maintenance log.
Establish and maintain laboratory testing logs for all analytical testing performed.
Apply and expand GLP principles department-wide.
Execute and document stability/compatibility testing meeting mandatory pull dates.
Collect, label, analyze, document, report, and communicate all analytical inspection activities.
Perform product assessments including Physical (Color, Odor, Appearance) and Analytical (Torque, Specific Gravity, pH, Viscosity) evaluations.
Analyze product characteristics against established specifications to determine disposition (pass/fail).
Escalate issues in a timely manner using appropriate terminology.
Facilitate and execute unique audit requests and testing under the guidance of the Quality supervisor.
Prepare sample submissions and related documentation for third-party testing.
Support production, warehouse, and quality personnel as required.
cond_0611.requirements:
Interest in quality and experience developing processes and documentation in a manufacturing or production environment.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Proficiency in Spanish is a plus.
Prior experience and knowledge in writing, developing, and implementing SOPs.
Ability to prioritize and adjust daily activities based on production urgency.
Bachelor's degree from an accredited university and/or specialty in Technical Writing.
Prior experience working in a regulated industry or liquid filling/manufacturing environment.
American Society for Quality (ASQ) Certified Quality Inspector (CQI).
